children.name: Didymochlaena
children.description: Didymochlaena — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Didymochlaena alpina
children.description: The native range of this species is Colombia to Venezuela and Peru. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
